evidence: src/business/logic/BoxOffice.ts: BoxOffice (constructor, purchase, admit, listing) accesses persistence exclusively through repository/store abstractions (EventStore and TicketStore) and operates on domain entities (Event, Ticket).
src/business/logic/GateLog.ts: GateLog.constructor injects the low-level ORM wrapper PrismaService instead of a domain repository/store abstraction.

src/business/logic/GateLog.ts: GateLog.scanned instantiates PrismaClient from @prisma/client directly (new PrismaClient()) and calls prisma.scan.create(...), bypassing both repository abstractions and its own injected PrismaService.
src/business/logic/GateLog.ts: GateLog.busiestGate calls this.prisma.scan.findMany() directly against the ORM client rather than reaching persistence through a repository or store port.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module src/business/logic fails to maintain a consistent persistence abstraction and boundary across its files. In src/business/logic/BoxOffice.ts, BoxOffice mediates all persistence operations through dedicated store abstractions (EventStore and TicketStore) and domain objects (Event and Ticket), including ticket admission scanning in BoxOffice.admit via TicketStore.markScanned. In contrast, src/business/logic/GateLog.ts bypasses the repository/store abstraction entirely and reaches persistence directly through the Prisma ORM client: GateLog injects PrismaService in its constructor and queries this.prisma.scan.findMany() directly in GateLog.busiestGate, while GateLog.scanned instantiates a raw PrismaClient from @prisma/client (bypassing even the injected PrismaService) to call prisma.scan.create().

violations.message: GateLog reaches persistence directly through the ORM client instead of a repository/store abstraction (unlike BoxOffice in src/business/logic/BoxOffice.ts, which uses EventStore and TicketStore): GateLog.constructor injects PrismaService, GateLog.busiestGate calls this.prisma.scan.findMany() directly, and GateLog.scanned instantiates a raw PrismaClient from @prisma/client (bypassing even PrismaService) to call prisma.scan.create().
